Description: QL is not calculating reserves for the following form numbers: 960 LP85-M, SAL ADB, 619 SPS PU, 1595 (667 ART), 1596 LO1.
Notes: 09/15/2026: The largest item is fixed and in the package. 667 ART (LifePRO holds $133,546 across 96 records) had no reserve at all because LifePRO keeps this plan's net premiums in the attained-age rate file and our rate load never read that file for net premiums; the plan now loads 1,736 net-premium rows and the loaded values match LifePRO to the cent on 94 of the 95 records that carry units. Nothing else in the rate package changed - all 22 other rate tables are identical. QLAdmin calculates the reserve dollars when valuation runs, so please confirm 667 ART reserves on the next UAT valuation. Four items still need input: 619 SPS PU and the two 1596 ADB riders (LifePRO $406, QL $123) have no row in the CSO Valuation Setup workbook, so they carry no mortality table, reserve interest or reserve method - we need those three values from CSO and cannot assume them. 960 LP85-M ($1,858, one policy) has valuation assumptions but LifePRO only stores 12 durations and the policy is at duration 57, so the reserve has to be computed by formula - separate actuarial question. 1595 WP, SAL ADB and 1596-667 ADB are the reverse of the reported problem - LifePRO's own ValX shows $0 on all three while QL shows $104 total, so please confirm whether any reserve is expected there. One 667 ART record (policy 9010886099, second coverage) carries a $1,317 reserve in LifePRO against zero units, which cannot be reproduced from a per-unit rate table - flagging it as a new question. An earlier reading of this issue pointed at underwriting-class keys; that was wrong and has been retracted. 09/16/2026: Compared LifePRO VALX to the 6/30 QuikValf after Jill confirmed L14 and said they were waiting on 667 ART. ShareFile CSO\L_Rate_Setup QuikNps (8,932,343 bytes, 9/15 10:37) and QuikPlTv (13,453 bytes) already have the ART fix — 1,736 5667AT net-premium rows, walked to VALX on 9010800356C / 9010768802C / 9010764248C. The valuation region still had the earlier 7:23 L14-only files (QuikNps 8,758,743 / QuikPlTv 13,321, zero ART rows), which is why ART is still $0. Asked them to size-check those two tables against ShareFile, reload, reindex, and revalue. 9/16/2026: Emailed Jill and Eric that the ART fix is in yesterday's ShareFile CSO\L_Rate_Setup drop and asked them to confirm QuikNps 8,932,343 bytes and QuikPlTv 13,453 bytes in the valuation region before they revalue; walked source net premium to VALX on 9010800356C $8,239, 9010768802C $490.35, and 9010764248C $474.50. 9/17/2026: Warren ran 6/30 valuation in his own Q test region with the confirmed-correct files and 9010800356C still reserved $0. Root cause #2 found: QuikPlTv carries two generations for 5667AT M/PR (EFFDATE 19000101 and 19950101) with identical MORT/RSVINT/RSVMETH (A1/G/3), but the 1,736-row NP grid from the 9/15 fix only loaded onto the 19000101 generation - QLAdmin's engine picks the newest EFFDATE <=  the valuation date (19950101), finds an empty NP grid there, and reserves $0 for every 5667AT policy regardless of issue date. Fix: added one PLAN_COPY row to the reviewed PSUBSSEG scope manifest (psubsseg_substitution_scope.csv) - "667 ART,5667AT,NP,19950101,667 ART 95,PLAN_COPY:5667AT,19950101,3,2,PDAGE;Rate_Table,Y" - using the same self-copy mechanism already proven on 670 GL85-8/17085M, mirroring the 19000101 NP grid onto 19950101. QuikNps 5667AT rows 1,736 -> 3,472 (both generations byte-identical); QuikPlTv unchanged (the 19950101 key rows already existed). Full batch rebuild (APP_VERSION v59.15) confirms only 5667AT QuikNps changed - the only other rate-table drift in this run is unrelated Issue #168 (1L14SC PQ/PR/ST classes, not Closed). validate_issue169_667art_np.py and validate_psubsseg_substitution.py both PASS. DBFs rebuilt via Desktop DBF Append Tool and the 23 rate tables redeployed to Q:\CSO\CSO_Test_6_30_2026 for Warren's next valuation pass. 9/17/2026 (second pass): Warren revalued and ART was still $0, so the EFFDATE reading above was also wrong and is retracted - QLAdmin resolves rate generations against the policy issue date, not the valuation date, so all 92 pre-1995 ART policies correctly land on the 19000101 generation that already carried the net premiums. The real cause is the reserve table, not the net premium table. QLAdmin builds the reserve as half of (prior-year terminal reserve + net premium + current-year terminal reserve), taking terminal reserves from QuikTvs and the net premium from QuikNps, and it will not pick the net premium up at all unless a QuikTvs row exists at the policy's generation, gender, class and issue age. 5667AT only ever received a QuikTvs grid through the 1995 substitution band, and only for the ST classes, so of the 94 policies in the 6/30 valuation exactly one could reach a row - 9011136641C, M/ST issued 2/24/1996 - and that one valued correctly at $98.25 off a 7.86 net premium, which is what proved the formula. The other 93 had no reserve row to read. Fix: 5,906 zero-terminal QuikTvs rows added for 5667AT covering M/F x PR/ST at both generations; zero is the correct terminal reserve for annually renewable term, so the entire reserve is the half-net-premium term. All three walked policies now compute exactly - 9010800356C $8,239.00, 9010768802C $490.35, 9010764248C $474.50 - and all 3,472 net premiums now have a reserve row behind them. The formula was verified independently against Issue #168's L14 figures, reproducing LifePRO's 636.23 and 659.72 per unit to the cent. Also found but not fixed in this pass: the same missing-reserve-row pattern affects 12 other plans, including L10 (5L0110, 122 policies all at $0) and L05 (5L0510, 5 of 10 at $0 - the L05 remainder left open on #168); plans whose net premiums all have a reserve row behind them come out 3.9% zero, the misaligned ones 85.6% zero. APP_VERSION v59.16; the patch is wired into the rate-emit finale so a re-emit cannot silently drop it, which is how #168 was lost on 9/16. validate_issue169_667art_tvs_reachable.py, validate_issue169_667art_np.py, validate_psubsseg_substitution.py and validate_issue168_l14_reserve_class_replication.py all PASS; DBFs rebuilt via the Desktop Append Tool and the 23 rate tables redeployed to Q:\CSO\CSO_Test_6_30_2026 (QuikTvs 92,654 -> 98,560 records, nothing else changed).
